module: Builds the canonical navigation entry (NavigationEntry) used everywhere in the router: {request, resolved, origin, toRoute, fromRoute, routeNode}. Once created, the entry is to be treated as immutable. Also provides the conversion to a storable/serializable form (without functions) and its validation.
notes: request = {name, fullRoute, params, query, options}; resolved = copy of the route configuration without children, onEnter, onMount, onLeave or functions, plus name, params, query and the extras (breadcrumbs, scope...). resolved.ui defaults to uiTypes {"angular", "vue"} and uiTypesFilter any.
request.params contains only the real screen parameters; the router's control keys (preferredScope, decorator, showDecorator...) stay in request.options so that reload/back can find them.
routeNode references the original route configuration (with its hooks); it is neither serialized nor restored (nil after fromStorable).
validate requires request.name (string), resolved.name (string), resolved.screenId (non-empty string) and resolved.ui.uiTypes (array).
Deprecated aliases kept: createNew (does nothing), create, toMinimal.

fullRoute.desc: Full reference base[:scope]; otherwise the canonical name.

createResolved.desc: Builds the resolved route from the route configuration, the request and extras (copy without hooks or functions).

toCompatRoute.desc: Reduced compatibility view of a resolved route.

returns.desc: {name, screenId (or name), params, meta} or nil.

createEntry.desc: Creates the full navigation entry, with origin = {route = name of the previous request} if a previous entry exists.

toStorable.desc: Copies the entry removing the functions from resolved and the routeNode, for serialization.

fromStorable.desc: Rebuilds an entry from stored data (routeNode = nil; toRoute recomputed if absent).

validate.desc: Validates the structure of a navigation entry.

create.desc: Deprecated alias: creates a request then the resolved route (moduleName added as extra).

toMinimal.desc: Deprecated alias: minimal view {name, params, query}.
